title: PUT /api/quick-access/{entity_id}
description: Admin only: sets the quick access level of one entity. level null = back to the domain default. 422 detail types: quick_access.not_allowed (level above the domain max, e.g. camera), quick_access.critical_ack_required (control for a critical entity without critical_ack: true; the Admin UI shows the warning about widgets, Control Center, Apple Watch, CarPlay, Siri and shared HomeView screens first). Every change is audited (quick_access_updated) and sends client_config_updated to the affected devices; the check sensors follow.

critical_ack.description: Confirms the warning for a critical entity (needed for control).
